description: Kindora gives nonprofits and researchers direct access to the philanthropic funding landscape. Search grantmakers by name, cause area, geography, size, or classification; review IRS 990 financial summaries and grant histories; find open foundation and government grant opportunities; analyze giving patterns; and browse philanthropy jobs. Results come from public filings, public funder websites, and Kindora's curated funder corpus. The submitted tools are free, read-only, and require no Kindora account.
